Meeting Finder

Product·by @jeetnirnejak·2026-08-26·inspora page·original post

What it is

Meeting Finder timezone widget: 4 city rows (San Francisco, New York, Sao Paulo, London), each a strip of colored hour-blocks across 24h; a draggable vertical scrubber sweeps the strips, highlighting the covered blocks and live-updating a status line ('1 of 4 in working hours' -> green 'Works for everyone'); 'Find best time' auto-snaps the scrubber to the optimal overlap.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-20%
Card 'Meeting Finder': rows of rounded hour-blocks per city, blocks colored by working-hours quality (blue, purple, magenta/pink, yellow) over a faint grey grid; scrubber parked mid-morning; status 'Off hours everywhere'; local times listed right.
20-45%
Scrubber drags right: blocks under it lift/highlight with a white ring; per-city local time labels update; status flips to '1 of 4 in working hours'.
45-65%
Scrubber near evening: '3 of 4, late in London'; block colors under the line brighten; a small tooltip clock rides the scrubber top.
65-85%
Sweep back left past midnight: 'Off hours everywhere' again; scrubber handle is a slim white rounded bar with a grip notch.
85-100%
'Find best time' clicked: scrubber animates by itself to the max-overlap slot, blocks for all four cities light, status turns green: 'Works for everyone'.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: a "Meeting Finder" timezone widget - 4 city rows (San Francisco, New York, Sao Paulo, London), each a strip of colored hour-blocks across 24h. A draggable vertical scrubber sweeps the strips, highlighting covered blocks and live-updating a status line ("1 of 4 in working hours" -> green "Works for everyone"). "Find best time" auto-snaps to the optimal overlap.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Card "Meeting Finder": 4 rows of rounded hour-blocks colored by working-hours quality (blue, purple, magenta/pink, yellow) over a faint grey grid; city names left, local times right. Scrubber: slim white rounded vertical bar with a grip notch; a small tooltip clock rides its top. Status line under the grid; "Find best time" button.

## Motion spec
Pattern: scrub + computed snap.
- Drag: scrubber x 1:1 under the pointer; blocks under it lift/highlight with a white ring and brighten immediately; per-city time labels update live; status line swaps text (150ms fade) through "1 of 4 in working hours", "3 of 4, late in London", "Off hours everywhere".
- Tooltip clock rides the scrubber top, showing the scrubbed reference time.
- Find best time: scrubber animates by itself to the max-overlap slot over 600ms ease-in-out; all four cities' blocks light; status turns green: "Works for everyone".

## Calibration
- Highlight response is immediate (no transition lag) - the scrubber must feel wired to the blocks.
- Auto-snap 600ms ease-in-out; slower feels indecisive, faster skips the "searching" read.
- Status color carries the verdict: muted greys until the green "Works for everyone".

## Reduced motion
Scrubber moves 1:1 (positional); auto-snap uses a 300ms linear tween; highlights without the ring lift.

## Don't miss
- Block colors encode working-hours quality before any scrubbing - the heat map is the baseline read.
- The scrubber handle is a slim bar with a grip notch, not a full-column highlight.
- "3 of 4, late in London" style nuance in the status line - name the laggard city.
